description: React component for managing system role permissions in Mattermost admin console, including rendering permission sections, subsections, and access controls.

classes.name: SystemRolePermission
classes.description: React component class for rendering and managing permissions for system roles in the admin console.

methods.name: isSectionVisible
methods.description: Determines if a permission section is visible based on props and current access level.

methods.name: renderSubsectionToggle
methods.description: Renders toggle button for showing/hiding subsections.

methods.name: renderSubsections
methods.description: Renders subsections of a permission section if visible.

methods.name: renderSectionRow
methods.description: Renders a single permission section row with title, description, and dropdown.

methods.name: getAccessForSection
methods.description: Calculates access level for a section based on subsections and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessForSectionByName
methods.description: Determines access for a section by its name, considering permissions and updates.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, rendering section and subsections.
